requirements: R1: Create a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root to start the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint to verify the launched stack.

slices.title: Add docker-compose and health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to create a docker-compose configuration, so that the full stack can be started with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run docker-compose up, Then all required services start successfully.
Given the running stack, When I query the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a successful response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce outdated materials in the catalog from >5% to 0%
requirements: R1: Implement UI controls to update existing epidemiological materials.
R2: Implement UI controls to delete existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Add UI controls for material update and deletion
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management for this epic, I want to add edit and delete actions to the UI, so that existing materials can be kept up to date.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the UI, When a user clicks delete, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint and updates the view.
Given an existing material, When a user edits and saves it, Then the frontend invokes the PUT API endpoint with the updated data.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce material modification time from >5 mins to <1 min

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to exactly 0
requirements: R1: Implement an authentication mechanism to verify user identity.
R2: Implement authorization to block unauthenticated access to the catalog and creation features.

slices.title: Implement authentication and authorization middleware
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to add authentication middleware, so that restricted data is protected from unauthorized access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access restricted features, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given an authenticated user, When they access the catalog, Then they can view and manage materials successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthenticated API access from >0 to 0
